author: ToolUp Analytics Ltd (UK)
name: ToolUp Platform SDK Application (additional app pair)
description: Adds a Server+Client application pair under src/ to an existing platformsdk-solution. The .sln, compose.yml, and Build.fs updates are surfaced as manual instructions; --port-server and --port-client-vite MUST be supplied and MUST NOT clash with any port already bound by the existing solution.

port-server.description: Server port (required). Must not clash with any port already bound by the existing solution — `tools/ToolUp.PortGuard` (run via scripts/New-ToolUpApp.ps1) can scan the solution tree and reject clashing values.

port-client-vite.description: Vite dev-server port (required). Same clash-rejection contract as --port-server.

postActions.description: Manual updates required to integrate the new app pair.

manualInstructions.text: Add the new <Name>-Server.fsproj and <Name>-Client.fsproj (matching the -n you passed) to your .sln.
Add a service entry to compose.yml exposing the --port-server value you passed.
Append build targets for the new app to Build.fs (Build.fs currently ships a single-Port BuildConfig; multi-app BuildConfig extension is a planned follow-up).
